claims.summary: The model-control-marker cleaner uses exact token identity, grammatical relation checks, delimiter depth, placement counts, and cleanup receipts.
claims.disposition: Verified against all 995 report-bound source lines. The implementation is deliberately exact and bounded rather than an open-ended semantic classifier.

claims.summary: The explicit relation vocabulary omitted common forms such as mimics and replicates, allowing an exact marker used as content to be removed.
claims.disposition: Implemented now. Added mimics and replicates to the exact relation vocabulary and to the report-grounded poetic-attribution regression table.

claims.summary: Nested exact marker references such as [[<MARKER>]] need a bounded delimiter-depth check.
claims.disposition: Verified existing. The parser has a maximum exact-reference delimiter depth and tests cover depths two and three plus deeper bounded behavior.

claims.summary: The relation vocabulary should be checked against ordinary model descriptions so content references remain consistent.
claims.disposition: Addressed for the two concrete report terms through exact additions and regression coverage. Future terms require source-grounded examples; no unrestricted vocabulary or semantic execution path was introduced.
